_comment: Qualifier labels in an investigation context.
The same +/- runs mean different things depending on where they appear. On
a symptom, '-' is a trend: the complaint is improving. On a laboratory or
imaging result, '-' is a result: the test is negative. Rendering 'HIV
improving' because the symptom table was applied to a lab line would be
both wrong and alarming, so the two vocabularies are kept separate and
These labels report what was recorded. They carry no ordering and no
significance: '+++' is labelled 'strongly positive' because that is what
the notation says, not because the engine judges it to matter more.
